notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least four.
description:
Cast Dockside Chef by paying {B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
Keimi enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Carnival of Souls.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Dockside Chef enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Carnival of Souls.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Hateful Eidolon from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Cast Hateful Eidolon by paying {B}.
Keimi triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Hateful Eidolon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Carnival of Souls.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Dockside Chef from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Cast Dockside Chef by paying {B}.
Keimi triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 6.
